data.text:
MCP tool diet: profiles lean 15 / families 24 / hot+families 36, search/call facade for tiny caps
Operator 2026-10-22 (MTD-decision, AskUserQuestion), chosen 'Families with an action + search/call facade for tiny windows': 24 tools as noun families (ddflow_gate action=record); old names hidden aliases for one deprecation window (two releases); per-client profiles chosen by cap and clientInfo.name: lean 15, families 24 (default), hot+families 36; 2-tool ddflow_search/ddflow_call facade for the smallest caps (no second dispatcher). Supersedes D-mcp-surface (1) 'no tool is renamed or merged'. See docs/ddflow/decisions/mcp-tool-diet.md.

data.body:
Express tiers as profiles keyed by family/action and by descriptor cap; choose by [caps] and initialize.clientInfo.name, never by a runtime call (listChanged stays false); per-profile byte report. This IS P-agent-parity.tool-profile and CP-mcp-profiles: fold them in, do not duplicate (close them as done-by when this lands). Source: docs/ddflow/research/mcp-tool-diet.md section 9. Conformance: declared-command matrix stays the single source (CLI/MCP parity), files under 20 KB, no private addresses or keys in tracked files.

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (operator, D-mcp-tool-families; docs/ddflow/decisions/mcp-tool-diet.md): profiles lean (15 tools), families (24, the default), hot+families (36); flat tiers opt-in; chosen from descriptor cap and clientInfo.name, never a runtime call.

Add family and action to Command in the declared-command matrix; import fails without one; generate the family/alias table from it (reuse Command.tier); the 15 families and 9 hot singles from the research mapping table (section 5). Source: docs/ddflow/research/mcp-tool-diet.md section 9. Conformance: declared-command matrix stays the single source (CLI/MCP parity), files under 20 KB, no private addresses or keys in tracked files.

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (operator, D-mcp-tool-families; docs/ddflow/decisions/mcp-tool-diet.md): 24 advertised tools = 9 hot singles + 15 noun families, action named like the CLI 'noun verb'; generated from the declared matrix.

Build family tool schemas in tools/list and tools/call: action enum, union params deduplicated, as_agent declared once, per-action required-parameter errors that name the action. Measure bytes per family against the research estimate (lower bound; expect ~10% more). Source: docs/ddflow/research/mcp-tool-diet.md section 9. Conformance: declared-command matrix stays the single source (CLI/MCP parity), files under 20 KB, no private addresses or keys in tracked files.

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (operator, D-mcp-tool-families; docs/ddflow/decisions/mcp-tool-diet.md): one tool per family with an action enum (ddflow_gate action=record); as_agent declared once; per-action required errors name the action.

Reuse PM-search-call as the facade for caps below 24; no second dispatcher; ddflow_search over family/action. Source: docs/ddflow/research/mcp-tool-diet.md section 9. Conformance: declared-command matrix stays the single source (CLI/MCP parity), files under 20 KB, no private addresses or keys in tracked files.

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (operator, D-mcp-tool-families; docs/ddflow/decisions/mcp-tool-diet.md): the 2-tool ddflow_search/ddflow_call facade serves the smallest caps (below 24); no second dispatcher.

Reuse registry.Alias: one per old name with its implied action, hidden from lists, once-per-session deprecation note, removed_in version; golden alias table. Old agents, hooks and permission files keep working through the window. Source: docs/ddflow/research/mcp-tool-diet.md section 9. Conformance: declared-command matrix stays the single source (CLI/MCP parity), files under 20 KB, no private addresses or keys in tracked files.

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (operator, D-mcp-tool-families; docs/ddflow/decisions/mcp-tool-diet.md): old names stay callable as hidden aliases for one deprecation window (two releases), once-per-session note, then MTD-sunset removes them.
